limitations: Material assets are editable stock UE candidates; the original private shaders and complete output wiring are not reconstructed.
Source JSON/Markdown records are editor-only evidence assets, not playable animation, cloth, Blueprint, Niagara or recovered material graphs.
Unavailable source texture references remain unavailable; stock helper textures do not count as converted game resources.
Environment assets are inactive candidates with documented unresolved fields; current viewer routing is unchanged.
ActorX preserves the exported highest LOD; original bone scales and tangent vectors were absent, and tangents are recomputed.
Structural/fresh-load verification does not establish target-RHI shader success, appearance, animation or device performance.

native_mesh_validation.mesh_description_mikk_zero_tangent_scope: Raw generated MeshDescription vertex-instance count, which may include vertices on the reported degenerate geometry/UV triangles. It is a different counting domain from built render-vertex tangent exceptions and need not be zero. Built nondegenerate frames must still verify with built_tangent_frames_invalid equal to zero.
native_mesh_validation.tangent_degeneracy_classification: Stable incident geometry requires finite triangle cross-product squared length >= UE_SMALL_NUMBER (1e-8), matching UE safe normalization, and finite absolute UV determinant > 1e-12. This is not MikkTSpace's internal degeneracy threshold. Near-degenerate exceptions touch a nonzero cross product below that geometry threshold and have no stable incident geometry/UV triangle.
native_mesh_validation.tangent_exception_policy: Only render vertices whose every incident built triangle has degenerate UVs or geometry, including geometry below the UE safe-normal threshold, may have a finite invalid tangent frame; these are counted separately and are not claimed as verified nondegenerate tangent frames. Nonfinite tangent vectors cannot receive an exception.
native_mesh_validation.tangent_orthogonality_metric_scope: Native per-mesh maximum includes degenerate exceptions; a separate exact maximum restricted to nondegenerate vertices is not emitted by the native report.
native_mesh_validation.corner_rebuild_comparison_scope: Before/after values describe each mesh's latest recorded MeshDescription Mikk rebuild. Before may already use an intermediate canonical layout; these totals are not claimed as the original pre-fix baseline.

png.validation_scope: PNG integrity and nonblank pixels; subject appearance still requires visual review

preview.asset_hash_binding: capture report records planned assets; per-capture package hashes were not recorded
limitations: Stock three-light inspection with manual exposure, not the recovered source lighting or camera.
Converted materials are documented stock approximations; original private shaders are not recovered.
Reference-pose capture does not verify animation, cloth, viewer interaction, other characters or iOS.
An active Metal shader map and nonblank PNG do not establish original-game visual equivalence.

ios.scope: C++ target compilation/linking only; does not verify iOS asset cooking, signing or device runtime.

viewer_integration_additions.scope: Exact approved viewer additions only. Original conversion index, source validation and rendered-evidence requirements are unchanged.

viewer_approval_scope: Current reports, saved package fingerprints and existing integration audit only; no new UE, shader or runtime test is performed.
